Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's demo

Hi Emma -

Thanks for taking the time today - great to learn more about StellarApps' roadmap for customer-facing AI assistants. Quick recap from our side: 

- Use case: in-app conversational assistant for support + knowledge base routing
- Target traffic: ~120k monthly active users, expected peak concurrency ~120 RPS
- Requirements: < 200ms p95 latency, European data residency for a subset of traffic, SOC2 evidence for audit

Next steps we agreed on:
1) I'll send a pricing + deployment options SOW you can share with procurement (attaching v1).
2) Lauren will coordinate the SOC2 artifact bundle you requested.
3) You to confirm timing: are you targeting a live pilot before EoQ (end of June) or early Q3?

I've attached the SOW + pricing workbook. If the pilot timeline is tight we can propose a minimal Dedicated pilot to lock throughput.

Best,
Aditya Rao

aditya@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

- Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (statement_of_work, 3 pages)
- Redwood_Pricing_Proposal.xlsx (pricing workbook)
